feedback_text: The dashboard takes nearly 30 seconds to load every morning.
It would be great if we could connect our account directly to Salesforce.
I can't access the admin settings even though I'm an account administrator.
The reporting dashboard is really easy to use and saves me a lot of time.
The application keeps crashing when I try to open a customer record.
Could you add the ability to schedule reports to be sent automatically?
I was charged twice for my subscription this month.
The initial account setup was straightforward and much easier than I expected.
It takes too many clicks to find the customer settings page.
Our Slack connection stopped syncing customer updates yesterday.
I'd like different team members to have different levels of access.
The analytics page has become noticeably slower since the latest update.
I can't generate the monthly report, so I can't complete our management reporting.
The sidebar makes it really easy to move between different sections.
New users on my team don't understand what they're supposed to do during setup.
The system logged me out three times today while I was working.
I'd like to be able to pay annually rather than monthly.
Can you add a dark mode?
Everything worked perfectly today.
The new update isn't what I expected and I'm not sure I like it.
